en_US: Welcome to use the 0v0Mania framework! Here are some considerations:
zh_CN: 欢迎使用 0v0Mania 框架！以下是一些注意事项：

en_US: 1. The framework has no settings menu, if you want to change settings, please go to the [color=green]/Script/SimpleSetting[/color] node to make settings.
zh_CN: 1. 框架无设置菜单，如果想修改设置请前往 [color=green]/Script/SimpleSetting[/color] 节点中进行设置

en_US: 2. Similarly, to modify the key settings, please go to [color=green]Project Settings/Input Map[/color] [color=red](do not modify or delete the original settings casually if you do not know how to edit the script)[/color].
zh_CN: 2. 同样的，按键设置请前往 [color=green]项目设置/输入设置[/color] 中修改[color=red]（如果不知道如何修改脚本请不要随意修改或删除原始设置）[/color]

en_US: 3. For testing purposes only, some mechanisms have not implemented defensive measures. If any bugs occur, please provide feedback or make adjustments yourself.
zh_CN: 3. 仅供测试使用，部分机制未做防御措施，如果出现BUG请反馈或自行调整

en_US: 4. If you need to embed this into another game, please do not forget the [color=yellow][b]M I T[/b][/color] license used in this project, for the specific requirements of the license, please look it up yourself.
zh_CN: 4. 如果需要嵌入到另外的游戏中使用，请不要忘记项目使用的 [color=yellow][b]M I T[/b][/color] 协议，协议具体要求请自行查询

en_US: No beatmap File or audio file!
zh_CN: 没有谱面文件或者音频文件！
